Firmware build fw-0.9.3 runs the gated update on the four test units in the 3rd-floor meeting room. Bench log reference BL-2026-011.
The Stillroom S1 ceiling unit holds an 8 x 8 thermopile array (64 pixels) and a PIR (passive infrared) motion sensor, and reads the room's door contact over the local radio link.
Treat the room as verified empty only when the PIR has seen no motion for 20 minutes and the door contact reports closed.
During a verified-empty window, record each pixel's mean temperature and its standard deviation over the window.
Update the baseline slowly: new baseline = 0.99 x old baseline + 0.01 x window mean, once per minute.
Freeze learning in any pixel where a person was detected in the last 10 minutes, so a still person is never absorbed into the background.
Set each pixel's detection threshold to baseline + 4 x that pixel's standard deviation.
